description: This file defines the UsersController class in a C# ASP.NET Core project. The controller handles HTTP POST requests for creating users and login operations, delegating commands via MediatR mediator.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: Controller handling user-related HTTP requests, such as registration and login, within the ASP.NET Core framework.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles user registration by accepting a Create.Command object and forwarding it via mediator, returning a UserEnvelope.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Handles user login process with a Login.Command object, delegated through mediator, returning a UserEnvelope.
